text_block_list.text:
It'd been a little while since I started
watching 
over Lucky Lilac's races with Orfevre.

The notebook I held in my hands was full of
my writing. Seeing 
her challenging Orfevre without giving up
inspired me… Before I knew it,
I found myself analyzing their races.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
……Thank ya… very much. 
I hope… you'll race with me next week.

The more I watched her… The more perfect
her racing seemed. 
She had the impressive form of a model student,
never breaking her composure,
not even on the track.

The crowd had shrunk over time,
but I stayed in the seats, 
deep in thought.
This race ended with Orfevre breaking 
away in the home stretch,
like every race before it.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ——It's self-destructive, ain't it?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Just Lala's fine.
That's what everyone calls me. Say, 
that notebook ya got there… Why,
I figured there was 
someone watchin' me closely,
but my goodness…

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Hmm… Ya got times, strategies,
and everything else in here. 
And your analysis is incredibly detailed,
too. 
…

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"How to get Lucky Lilac acknowledged by
Orfevre…"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
…… Trainer,
I'm going to the locker room to change. 
…Once I'm back,
would ya give me a moment of your time?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
——Orfe-san, she's my… 
My inspiration.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: I used to think racing was just a form of entertainment. Umamusume running, and nothing more than that. But in the midst of that, I saw her running…

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
——She stood elegantly,
tall and proud. Her every step 
seemed to send a storm of blooming flowers
scattering beneath her feet.
It set my heart aflutter.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"I want to be a racer like her.
An Umamusume who captivates 
everyone… The flower of the flock.
The star of the show." …Before I knew it,
my inspiration became my dream.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
……Since then,
I devoted myself to training.
Eventually I 
reached the point where my teachers all told
me I could debut whenever I wanted.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
But… A simple debut wouldn't make me the
star I wanted 
to be. If I wanted to shine like gold,
the way she did… 
…Just being excellent wouldn't be enough.
choice_data_list: And that's why you're racing Orfe?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I want to debut as a racer who was
acknowledged by Orfe-san.
So I asked to race her… and she was kind
enough to 
allow it.

Even someone as domineering as Orfevre was
willing to clear 
her weekends to race Lucky Lilac.
That fact should've been 
more than enough to prove her high value as
a racer.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
At any rate… I haven't the slightest clue
what it is that I'm missing.
But there has to be some way for me to gain
her 
approval…

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
And to that point, I'd like to ask ya,
Trainer. 
Did ya happen to figure anythin' out when
ya watched our races?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
…I see.
I appreciate your concern regardless. 
I'll see if I can't come up with somethin'
myself.

I couldn't detect a hint of disappointment
or worry in her smile.
Assuming she wasn't just putting up 
a strong face… Her tenacity was
unbelievable.
choice_data_list: Why do you push yourself so much?
Why do you push yourself so much?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
…The way I see it,
perseverance is beauty. That's why.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Well, if ya do think of something,
don't hesitate to give me a shout.
So long as Orfe-san doesn't give 
up on me,
I'll always be there at the track.

…I didn't help her in the slightest.
If only there was something, 
even something small I could do… I thought
long and hard, 
and at the end what I came up with was——

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Trainer? 
Do ya have something ya want to tell me?
choice_data_list: I don't… My bed. Snork mimimi.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
…… 
Haha. You're quite the cheerful one, ain't ya,
Trainer?

Her kind smile made me cringe at myself
hard… Even if I 
wanted to help her,
I shouldn't have done something I wasn't 
used to.

If I really wanted to help her… There was
only one thing I could 
do. And that was to see my work as a trainer
through to the end.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
…Ya mean… My races with Orfe-san? 
Or are ya talking about me?
choice_data_list: Please, show me how you train.
Please, show me how you train.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: …I suppose you're serious about this.
choice_data_list: I want to find out what you're mis...
I want to find out what you're mis...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
……I appreciate it.
I can't thank ya enough. 
To tell ya the truth,
I've been at a loss myself.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to your help,
Trainer. 
Let's find what it is I'm missing
together.
choice_data_list: 'll do my best. Nice to work with you!
'll do my best. Nice to work with you!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Seems like I found myself an unexpected ally.
Everyone else 
seems to think gettin' Orfe-san to approve
of me's a pipe dream…)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(But that trainer was willin' to help me
find a way. 
A new point of view could be just what I
needed.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(…Quite the interesting person,
that trainer. 
In more ways than one…)
"I don't… My bed. Snork mimimi."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
…………Because it's bedtime. 
……………

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: WHAT DA HECK WAZZAT!?
